program: Disability rights, protection and advocacy, and community integration

what: Equip for Equality protects the civil rights of people with disabilities through legal advocacy, investigation and education.
Its Cook County community-integration litigation seeks appropriate supports so nursing-home residents can live safely in the community.
The statewide recipient also works on education, employment and access to services.
strengths: Rights enforcement can connect people with safer care and practical supports.
Cook County litigation provides a concrete local implementation mechanism.
Original audited accounts identify government funding and contributed resources.
reservations: No verified local incremental health or net household-resource cohort was identified.
Existing decrees, public care and other counsel prevent assigning all transitions to a donation.
Unrecognized pro bono resources, unsafe transitions and caregiver/payer costs may materially change the comparison.

sections.what: Equip for Equality, EIN36-3361312, is Illinois's designated protection and advocacy organization. Its Colbert work concerns Medicaid-eligible disabled nursing-home residents in Cook County, within the Chicago metro; other statewide work is not assigned wholesale to Chicago. [Official systemic work](https://www.equipforequality.org/systemic-litigation/)
sections.monitoring: The FY2025 court-filed plan requires outreach, assessment, service planning, transition and quality reporting. It explicitly notes that some new compliance data had not yet been reliability-validated. Commitments are not verified completed transitions, additional safe placements or measured QALYs. Request unique local clients, safe retained placements, health changes, resources, burdens and actual alternative help. [Primary implementation plan](https://www.equipforequality.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/Colbert-IP-FY-2025.pdf)
sections.qualitative: Safer community support, prevented neglect and appropriate access can improve health, but transition without sufficient care can cause harm. Autonomy and legal rights have value beyond clinical utility; this initial model does not turn every legal victory into health. Existing decree obligations, public Medicaid care and other plaintiff counsel remain in the counterfactual; shared transitions are not credited in full to each organization. No clinically calibrated local effect was identified in this bounded review. The100-household reference, .2 clinical additionality, .5 annual-work response, .1 annual utility and two-year duration are transparent planning judgments, not observed causal rates. No lifetime survivor earnings or automatic family multiplier is used.
sections.cost:
FY2024 audited recognized expense is $9,770,963, including $117,984 contributed nonfinancial assets. Revenue is $9,408,652 and government funding $7,442,120. Central recognized-cost accounting does not include approximately $1.8 million additional unrecognized professional services noted in the audit; the explicit $11,570,963 sensitivity adds that approximate external resource value without duplicating recognized donations. It is not evidence that all volunteer time sacrifices billable household income. [Original audit](https://www.equipforequality.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/EFE-Single-Audit-9.30.24-FINAL.pdf)

A hypothetical100 local households × .5 annual-funded-work response yields50 incremental resource-exposedHH. Clinical additionality .2 gives10 changed clinical trajectories, .1 utility for two discounted years:1.913470 clinicalQALYs. Financial .2 implies10 resource-changingHH. Their judged one-time $1500 net resource gain is halved for health overlap and netted against full$100 process/work/care burden BEFORE log, yielding$650;40 otherHH lose$100. One modeled welfareperson per household and$20k annual household baseline produce .5×[10log1.0325+40log.995]/1.03=.0579266 welfare-equivalent healthyyears. All negative changes remain full and clinical-null retains resources.

Combined1.971396 equivalents imply $49.563667 million per ten combined equivalents, not a measured marginal donation return. Full statewide annual recipient expense remains the denominator while only this finite Cook branch is priced. b=1 sensitivity exposes annual-response assumptions. Central payer neutrality is UNKNOWN, not factualzero; matched transfer and adverse cases price signed local payer loss. Nonlocal costs, additional caregiver/provider burdens and wider portfolio effects remain unpriced, so this is not complete worldEV.
sections.funding: The2024 audit reports net assets$2,977,296, unrestricted$2,633,895 and restricted$343,401. Heavy government support complicates donor additionality; there is no verified marginal general-support expansion tranche. Ordinary gifts support the statewide recipient, not a ring-fenced Colbert project. [Official giving](https://www.equipforequality.org/give/) The audit opinion is dated May 29, 2025; this is not verified publication time. Root independently read official FY2023 and FY2022 audits with expenses $9,358,418 and $8,102,494. Together with 2024, the descriptive annual mean is $9,077,291.67, not a forecast.

model.costScope: Whole statewide annual recognized recipient expense; conditional finite Cook health/resource component, unrecognized professional costs separate stress, not measured marginal-gift yield.
model.geographicAttribution: Cook County branch within Chicago–Naperville–Elgin current OMB boundary; no statewide outcomes silently assigned local.
model.formula: Clinical=g*N*a*b*q*sum(y=0..T-1)(1+d)^-(delay+y)-g*N*b*harm/(1+d)^delay. Household resource=.5*people*discountedlog(1+signedjointnet/baseline), positive-only recipient overlap. Combined=clinical+resource;price10=10*C/Combined only if known andpositive.
model.counterfactual: Existing public P&A support, decree implementation, Medicaid/community services and alternative counsel continue. b is conditional annual-package response not an extra donor haircut on measured effects.
model.attribution: Hypothetical distinct local household cohort; one clinical person/one welfareperson per household. Different clinical/resource resolutions are not inferred from raw litigation output. No repeated lifetime or gross salary credit.
model.uncertainty: All effect and resource conversions are judgments; source evidence establishes scope and cost, not causal QALYs. Full portfolio unknown is explicitly null.
model.nativeOutcomes: Planning reference100 distinct local households,50 annual-response exposedHH,10 incremental clinical trajectories and10 resource-changingHH; no observed completion counts claimed.
